name: stock_quick_count_line
description: GH #4564 / REQ-854. The one line of a quick count document. header_id is the record_id of the stock_quick_count header (not the document id); the foreign_keys entry fk_stock_quick_count_line_header_id promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT (inert on the soft-delete path). org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). line_no is always 1. location_id and responsible_id (optional) are record ids of modules locations and org, catalog_item_id, catalog_uom_id and catalog_lot_id of module catalog_items (other packs: no foreign key; the module checks them at the route). counted_quantity is the number the storekeeper counted (0 allowed), book_quantity the balance of the key read in the same transaction, difference = counted_quantity minus book_quantity: all exact decimals (precision 24, scale 9, decimal_strict), the difference may be negative. Written only by module stock; after issue nothing of the line changes.
